status.summary: Read: 188 of 192 letters. The other 4 are isolated divergences, present both in the thesis and in its 2008 reprint.

found_by: Published: Núñez de Prado y Clavell (1992), doctoral thesis, Universidad Complutense de Madrid, p. 195, with the plaintext of the telegram; reprinted by Soler Fuensanta and López-Brea Espiau, Soldados sin rostro (2008), pp. 138-139.
archive: Published source; the telegram in clear is cited by the thesis as SHM, Arm. 11, Rol. 92, Leg. 561, Carp. 124, Doc. 1

E. averiguar> AVHL IXRN ARMZ GYXE ISZJ KGZA JQRK PKWA CDVN JCTG RLPH VCKC KFBS OLVJ TMCI BOBS JGLF RBHI XMEV
published_plaintext: Radio Tetuán en su emisión de las 4 de la tarde dio la noticia falsa de toma de estaciones Las Rozas y Las Matas. También afirmó que en Madrid esperan ataque fuerzas nacionales. Sírvase V. E. averiguar origen noticias falsas y castigar responsables su propagación dándome cuenta.
notes: From another collection and another link. The cryptogram is the one printed in the thesis (p. 195), which underlines group 3, MVNR, as the key; its 2008 reprint differs from it in 18 letters, two of them in header groups 1 and 2 (HPVO EVWO). Three passages were sent in clear; they are marked <PLAIN: ...> in the body, and the rotor state runs across them. Two of them are preceded by the W padding of the manual (TARDE WW, NACIONALES WWW). The message took no part in building the model or the search. The published rendering of the plaintext is abridged (it drops DICHAS in ORIGEN DICHAS NOTICIAS FALSAS). Reference: 53 is the number of groups of the telegram, header and garble check included (4 + 48 + 1).

solution.plaintext_emended_note: The 4 divergent positions emended: what the operator presumably typed. No key produces it from this cipher.
solution.reading: ... EN SU EMISION DE LAS CUATRO DE LA TARDE ... FALSA DE TOMA DE ESTACIONES LAS ROZAS Y LAS MATAS ... QUE EN MADRID ESPERAN ATAQUE FUERZAS NACIONALES ... ORIGEN DICHAS NOTICIAS FALSAS Y CASTIGAR RESPONSABLES SU PROPAGACION DANDOME CUENTA
solution.command_note: LASROZAS, CASTIGAR and RESPONSABLES each give the same key on their own.
solution.rotor_I: Rotor I is in the middle slot at ring S. Its window runs from N to U inside the message without carrying the left rotor on, so its turnover letter is not N to U.

divergences.note: 1-based positions in the cipher, passages in clear removed. read is the engine's letter, expected the letter the plaintext requires. They are isolated, in four different groups and fixed under any change of key, and the thesis and its reprint agree on them: slips of the operator or of the copy the thesis worked from, not of the model.
